name: weather
description: Query weather for a city using Open-Meteo API

city.description: City name in English, e.g. Beijing

name: time_now
description: Get the current system time and date

name: calc
description: Evaluate a simple math expression

name: web_search
description: Enterprise web search with provider fallback, retry, rate limit, local cache, source ranking, credibility score, freshness score, and provider attempts.

providers.description: Optional provider order: tavily, serpapi, bing, duckduckgo

use_cache.description: Use local search cache, default true

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch or render a public web page by URL with cache, retry, rate limit, source quality score, cleaned text, links, status/final URL, and optional RAG ingestion.

max_chars.description: Maximum cleaned text characters to return, default 4000

render_js.description: If true, try Playwright browser rendering for JS-heavy pages

use_cache.description: Use local fetch cache, default true

ingest.description: If true, save, chunk, index, and add the page to the knowledge base

name: web_citation_check
description: Check whether answer claims are supported by source snippets/text and return an anti-hallucination gate with required rework for unsupported claims.

min_overlap.description: Minimum token overlap required for support, default 0.34

name: web_search_benchmark
description: Run an offline search evidence acceptance suite covering source ranking, freshness scoring, and citation consistency gate.

name: todo_list
description: Manage a persistent todo list (read/add/done/clear)

name: note_save
description: Save a text note

name: note_read
description: Read a saved note

name: note_list
description: List all saved notes

name: tools_list
description: List all local tools available to ClawOS with their descriptions

name: skill_register
description: Register a new solidified skill from a workflow demonstration. Once registered, skills execute locally in <1 second.

name.description: Display name of the skill, e.g. 'Organize Reports'

steps.description: List of tool steps, each with 'tool' and 'args' keys

name: skill_list
description: List all solidified skills, optionally filtered by category (research/competition/dev/office/general)

name: skill_execute
description: Execute a solidified skill locally, achieving sub-second response without LLM routing

name.description: Name of the skill to execute

params.description: Optional parameter overrides for the skill steps

name: skill_delete
description: Delete a registered solidified skill

name.description: Name of the skill to delete

name: file_organize
description: Organize files in a directory by extension, date, or pattern. Groups files into subdirectories automatically.

dry_run.description: If true, preview changes without moving files

name: text_stats
description: Analyze text statistics: word count, character count, reading time, language detection. Useful for research papers, reports, and documents.

file_path.description: Path to a file to analyze

name: meeting_action_items
description: Extract meeting decisions, action items, risks, blockers, and next agenda from a transcript or transcript file. Useful for meeting minutes, project syncs, and work follow-up.

name: paper_deep_read
description: Create a structured deep-reading brief for papers or research notes: summary, method, evidence, findings, limitations, concepts, and self-check questions.

name: exam_practice_builder
description: Build an exam practice set from topics or syllabus with questions, answer keys, rubric, difficulty mix, and review plan.

name: work_brief_builder
description: Turn messy work context into an executive brief, goals, stakeholders, milestones, and risk register. Useful for reports, weekly updates, project delivery, and workplace planning.

name: research_experiment_plan
description: Create a reproducible research experiment plan with hypothesis, datasets, baselines, metrics, steps, and expected artifacts.

name: batch_rename
description: Batch rename files in a directory using prefix, suffix, replace, or serial numbering rules.

path.description: Directory path containing files to rename

name: project_init
description: Scaffold a new project directory with standard structure for Python, web, research, or competition projects.

root.description: Root directory for the project, defaults to Desktop

name: timer
description: Set a timer or pomodoro session for focused work. Check timer status with action=status.

action.description: Start new timer or check current status

name: meeting_template
description: Generate a meeting notes template with agenda, decisions, action items sections. Saves as a markdown file.

name: ls
description: List directory contents with filtering by pattern, recursive option, sorting by name/size/modified time

name: cat
description: Read file contents with optional line range selection. Returns total lines and content.

name: find_files
description: Search files by name pattern recursively in a directory tree. Returns matching files with metadata.

name: grep_text
description: Search text content in files within a directory. Like grep, returns matching lines with file and line number.

path.description: Directory or file path to search

name: file_info
description: Get detailed file metadata: size, created/modified/accessed timestamps, permissions, extension

name: code_stats
description: Count lines of code by programming language in a directory. Detects Python, JS, TS, Go, Rust, C, Java, HTML, CSS, Markdown and more.

name: find_todos
description: Find TODO, FIXME, HACK, NOTE, XXX, BUG comments in source code files

path.description: Directory or file path to scan

name: dir_tree
description: Render a visual directory tree structure showing folder hierarchy

name: memory_profile_set
description: Set a user profile field in MemoryOS (name, interests, skills, research direction, etc.)

name: memory_profile_get
description: Get user profile info from MemoryOS. If key is empty, returns all profiles.

key.description: Profile field name to retrieve, empty for all

name: memory_preference_set
description: Set a user preference in MemoryOS (writing style, code style, communication preference, etc.)

name: memory_preference_get
description: Get user preferences from MemoryOS

name: memory_stats
description: Get MemoryOS statistics: profile count, preference count, conversation count, project count

name: memory_history
description: Get recent conversation history from MemoryOS for a session

name: reflection_trigger
description: Trigger a reflection cycle on recent conversations and tool executions. Analyzes successes and failures, extracts lessons, and stores in MemoryOS.

name: reflection_list
description: List recent reflection cards stored in MemoryOS with outcomes and lessons learned.

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return

name: file_write
description: Write content to a file on disk. Creates parent directories automatically. Use this to save generated code, notes, or any text output to a file.

path.description: Full file path including filename and extension

content.description: Text content to write to the file

append.description: If true, append to existing file instead of overwriting

name: shell_exec
description: Execute a shell command on the local machine (Windows uses PowerShell, Linux uses bash). Use for: compiling code, running scripts, checking installed tools. Max 60 seconds. Returns exit_code, stdout, stderr.

workdir.description: Working directory, defaults to current dir

name: meeting_workflow
description: Run the meeting lifecycle: create/process/get meetings, import local audio with sidecar transcripts and speaker labels, and draft calendar/email connector files without sending.

name: research_pdf
description: Import/search local research PDFs, mark OCR-needed pages, validate citations, build comparison matrices, create reproducible workflows, and generate self-questioning paper learning analysis files.

name: learning_workspace
description: Create learning goals, record evidence-based reviews and mistakes, build learning graphs, and calculate long-term mastery.

name: office_artifact
description: Create and lightly edit portable Office files using built-in OpenXML helpers: XLSX spreadsheets and PPTX presentations without requiring Microsoft Office, openpyxl, or python-pptx.

name: git_workspace
description: Inspect Git repos, prepare dry-run plans, create approval-gated commit requests, approve commits, and revert committed requests for rollback.

name: skill_governance
description: Govern self-evolving skills with dependency manifests, signatures, fresh-agent audits, and canary metadata before promotion.

name: competition_delivery_package
description: Build an enterprise-grade competition delivery package from project evidence: executive brief, technical evidence, demo runbook, judge Q&A, risk register, and index.

root.description: Project root containing README, project context, business plan, architecture notes, and ClawOS docs

output_dir.description: Directory where the generated delivery package should be written

project_name.description: Project or product name, default ClawOS

scenario.description: Competition or enterprise delivery scenario label

name: multi_agent_review_committee
description: Run a fixed-role multi-agent execution squad over the ClawOS delivery package: Planner, Research, Builder, Reviewer, Risk, and Judge produce a trace, quality gate, arbitration rounds, priorities, and knowledge-base items.

output_dir.description: Directory where generated delivery and committee artifacts should be written

project_name.description: Project or product name, default ClawOS

focus.description: Review focus, such as final submission readiness or complex task acceptance

delivery_package.description: Optional existing competition_delivery_package result to review

final_min_score.description: Minimum final score for the quality gate

risk_min_score.description: Minimum RiskAgent score for the quality gate

judge_min_score.description: Minimum JudgeAgent score for the quality gate

name: template_list
description: List versioned project templates available in the local template center.

name: template_instantiate
description: Instantiate a versioned project template atomically at an allowed local path. Requires explicit confirmation.
